Disassembly of _$s9Benchmark9makeImage8SwiftJLS0C0VyKF (0x100005cac), _$s8SwiftJLS16ImageDestinationC8allocate18admittedDescriptor6limitsAcA0cG0V_AA14ResourceLimitsVtKFZTf4nnd_n (0x1000106d4), _$s8SwiftJLS17OwnedImageStorageC16allocateReserved9byteCount6limitsAC7storage_AA0E10WriteLeaseV5leasetSi_AA14ResourceLimitsVtKFZ (0x100015630), _$s8SwiftJLS16ImageDestinationC5write8metadata_AA0C0VAA0C8MetadataV_ySwKXEtKF (0x10000faac), and _$s8SwiftJLS16ImageDestinationCfd (0x10000f844) shows that the remaining instructions in prepare (~2.9-3.0 us = 70-73 ticks of 41.67 ns at 37x23) are required contract admission, UUID/lease identity, mutex/atomic borrow-safety, and pixel fill operations.

Disassembly of decodeFlatRegion<NativeUInt16Writer> (0x1000452b8) and JPEGLSBitstreamReader.readBits (0x10002cb64) shows that remaining per-pixel checks are checked-arithmetic and bitstream-bounds guards required by the non-negotiable engineering rules.
